_about: servo models for the sim, one per tuning preset. fit_servo.py fills them from a `sweep` step test; unfitted ones are a copy of 'sim'.

strong.source: from your servotest.txt step timings (30 deg thigh/knee steps, 100 Hz log): starts ~5 ms, at target ~50 ms, ~1 deg overshoot = the 'sim' model within the 10 ms log resolution (and the backflip matches the sim). Kept = sim.

normal.source: NOT MEASURED YET - copy of 'sim' (preset 'Normal (walk / demo)')

silent.source: from your servotest.txt step timings (30 deg thigh/knee steps, 100 Hz log): starts <10 ms, at target ~55 ms, 0.3-0.7 deg steady offset (not modelled). Provisional: run fit_servo.py servotest.txt for the full fit.

default.source: from your servotest.txt step timings (30 deg thigh/knee steps, 100 Hz log): starts 10-20 ms late, at target ~70 ms. Provisional: run fit_servo.py servotest.txt for the full fit.
